title: Can the WoW Social team take on Maisara Caverns…

author: World of Warcraft
description:
The Prey system is a new opt-in open-world challenge coming with World of Warcraft: Midnight that lets players hunt powerful elite targets across the expansion’s zones, but with a twist: your chosen prey can hunt you in return. Join Fiamma as she breaks down everything you need to know about the Prey system, surviving elite encounters, and claiming your rewards.

Pre-purchase or upgrade to the World of Warcraft: Midnight Epic Edition for instant beta access: https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/midnight
